retry_reconciliation_contract.same_stage_retry_policy: Open retry requests and active contamination barriers produced by prior rejected Stage6 transitions are expected inputs to a Stage6 retry. They are blockers for downstream Stage7 consumption, but they are not independent blockers for promoting the refined Stage6 transition when all current Stage6 contract, LLM, action-audit, and quality checks pass. SACG promotion of the new Stage6 transition closes matching retry requests and supersedes barriers for regenerated Stage6 artifacts.

verification_execution_policy.acceptance: Real current-source VCS compilation, elaboration and linking; simulator execution and numerical comparison are not acceptance prerequisites.
verification_execution_policy.executor: accagent/framework/stage_verification.py: compile_only_stage_gates and compile_only_required_gates_by_level select the existing layer tools in bottom-up order

existing_tool_modes.case_leaf_functional: scripts/verification/case_leaf_operator_verify.py: current-source VCS compile-only evidence for operator leaves
existing_tool_modes.case_single_layer_functional: scripts/verification/case_single_layer_stream_sim.py: current-source VCS compile-only evidence for the connected kernel
existing_tool_modes.case_vcs_functional_sim: scripts/verification/case_board_vcs_functional.py: compile-only VCS evidence for the exact discovered board wrapper; simulation is not invoked

verification_execution_policy.planning_boundary: Historical functional/golden DAG nodes describe optional diagnostic capabilities. Missing runtime/golden results and layer certificates are downstream execution obligations during verification_artifacts planning, not missing compile-only capabilities. Use existing tool roles; do not invent another compile-only runner merely because a role retains a functional_sim name.

anti_spin_policy.current_layer_failure_after_lower_pass_m: debug current-layer integration, interconnect, wrapper, scheduler, data order, or boundary contract first
reopening_lower_layer_requires: a current-layer boundary trace record that directly contradicts lower-layer pass evidence
or a SACG-approved design-contract change invalidating the previous lower-layer evidence
when_reopened: record the contradicted lower-layer gate/module and source trace in SACG
rerun only the challenged lower-layer scope with expanded boundary stimuli or corrected contract
after lower-layer revalidation, rerun the failed current layer before any higher-layer promotion

cctg_policy.first_action_when_trace_missing: debug_trace_rerun for the failed current-layer gate
cctg_policy.localized_action: causal_slice_repair over the localized boundary or current-layer integration slice
cctg_policy.purpose: speed root-cause localization by mapping real-tool symptoms to the earliest violated contract/boundary
